What is CS EduTrack?

CS EduTrack is a web-based school management platform. It replaces paper registers, spreadsheets and scattered chat groups with one system every person at your school can use.

Without CS EduTrack

  • Paper attendance registers
  • Fee records in spreadsheets
  • Marks collected by hand
  • Parents phone the office for updates

With CS EduTrack

  • Attendance marked online, by class or by QR
  • Fees, invoices and dues tracked automatically
  • Marks entered once, visible to parents
  • Parents check everything on their phone

Common questions.

Can we try it before buying?

Yes. Open the live application or book a guided walkthrough.

Is our data separate from other schools?

Yes. Each school has its own workspace, and users see only what their role allows.

Does it work on phones?

Yes, in any mobile browser. An Android app is planned.

Can we import existing students?

Yes. Students can be imported in bulk during setup.

What we collect

CS EduTrack processes student, parent and staff details, attendance, academic records and fee information on behalf of each school.

Data is used only to provide the school management service. Each school's data is kept separate, and users see only what their role allows.
